title:
Quiet Nashville
2BR, Fenced Yard, 15 Min Downtown
description:
Quiet. Private. Spacious. Close to downtown.

Enjoy local artwork, books, historic guitars and musical treasures celebrating Nashville’s creative spirit. Relax in the private fenced backyard and watch the birds and butterflies.

Only 15 minutes from downtown, five minutes from shopping and convenient to the airport. Due to owner’s allergies, Please no animals.

The space
This cozy 2 bedroom home is set up for comfort:

Bedroom:  2 Queen bed (sleeps 4 )

Living Room: Comfy couch (great for lounging, not ideal for overnight sleeping)

Bathroom: Full bath with tub/shower combo

Bonus: In-unit washer & dryer for longer stays

Perfect for solo travelers, couples, or working professionals (yes, there's fast Wi-Fi).

🏡 Home Features & Amenities:

Private Entrance

Full Kitchen with cookware, utensils, and essentials

Smart TV with streaming capabilities

High-Speed Wi-Fi — reliable for remote work

In-Unit Washer & Dryer

Central Heating & Air Conditioning

Dedicated Workspace (small desk setup)

Driveway Parking for 1–2 cars

Fenced Backyard — Access to a big backyard, perfect for relaxing.

Guest access
Guests have access to the whole house and the outdoor patio.

Other things to note
🔒 Additional Notes
Due to own’s allergies please no animals. 

No smoking or parties.

Quiet hours: 9 PM – 9 AM

Monthly stays are welcome!
